title: Supported target models on affine opens
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], a compatible global scalar f [def-sc-derived-global-scalar], and a quasi-coherent derived object Eprime [def-pc-derived-category] whose cohomology stalks vanish outside V(f), fix an affine open U and integer k. Put A=Gamma(U,O_X), R=derived over-site restriction. For every F:D(A) -> D(O_X over U) naturally identifying Q followed by F with Q of termwise affinePerfectSheafification [lem-pc-affine-perfect-module-model], there exists M in D(A) with F(M) isomorphic to R(Eprime[k]); for every integer i and element m of H^i(M), some natural n satisfies (f|U)^n m=0. There is no perfect source or finite generation hypothesis, and no uniform exponent is asserted.

source.place: Tag 08EJ, affine support paragraph; Tag 06Z0 exact associated sheaf

proof.text: Apply [new-affine-open-supported-model-exists] to the shifted restricted quasi-coherent target to obtain M and its comparison hM. Apply [new-affine-open-supported-model-torsion] to that same M and hM. Pair the elementwise torsion result with hM. The existential witness is used only in a theorem proof; no definition chooses arbitrary data from this existence statement.

proof_origin.note: A decomposition: combine affine preimage existence with support-to-elementwise-torsion for a given preimage. One original hole replaced by two strictly smaller holes.
